bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-ui-05849c)" || exit 62
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 9483f0c7f73644a6258a15610b5a3fd23b5e56f0 || exit 64
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py)" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py)" || exit 65
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-photo-verified.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py"
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 66
if PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_photo_caption_smoke >"$tmp/result.txt" 2>&1; then
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 67
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 68
 echo LINK_PHOTO_REGISTER_EDIT_E2E=PASS
else
 reason="$(sed -n 's/^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=//p' "$tmp/result.txt" | head -1)"
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 69
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 70
 case "$reason" in
  *EXISTING_DRAFT_BLOCKED*)exit 81;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_MENU*|*MENU_NOT_FOUND*)exit 82;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_PHOTO*)exit 83;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_PAIR*)exit 84;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_REGISTER*)exit 85;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_EDIT*|*EDIT_PREVIEW*)exit 86;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_REREGISTER*)exit 87;;
  *REGISTERED_CODE_MISSING*|*EDIT_CODE_CHANGED*)exit 88;;
  *SCREEN_NOT_FOUND*)exit 89;;
  *)exit 90;;
 esac
fi
